text:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Canary deploy started rev=2026.03.15-rc5 region=eu-west-1 shard=gpu-pool-3
arya (oncall-sre): alerting 500s on accounts-service in canary within 90s of start
arya (oncall-sre): paging DB oncall @miguel 1
miguel (db): got it. checking migrations included in rev. Found migration 20260315_add_email_verified on release branch. Current status: waiting for lock on relation \"users\"
sara (backend): stacktrace from accounts-service: KeyError on access to `email_verified`. We likely hit code path that expects new column present
incident-bot: PagerDuty INC-2026-241 created. Severity P2. Impact: user signup and auth lookups failing for subset of canary traffic
noah (oncall-sre): can we toggle feature flag `ff.newAccountPath` to off while we investigate?
tess (product): thumbs up to kill the feature flag for safety. Notify CS afterwards
liam (support): getting inbound messages from enterprise customer \"acme-corp\" and two others. Marking as potentially impacted
miguel (db): looking at pg_locks: blocking pid is 10123 running `analytics-export --copy users` started by cron at 02:00. It holds an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock on users. Migration waiting.
arya (oncall-sre): immediate plan: 1) stop canary traffic, 2) disable feature flag, 3) decide whether to terminate analytics session or wait for it to finish. Any objections?
sara (backend): disabling flag prevents new code path; we should still avoid killing sessions if data loss risk. But analytics job is a copy/export; safe to terminate for this window
noah (oncall-sre): i'll stop canary now 1 `deploy-bot stop_canary rev=2026.03.15-rc5 region=eu-west-1`
deploy-bot: acknowledged. Canary traffic stopped, routing reverted to stable
noah (oncall-sre): toggling flag: `POST /internal/flags/ff.newAccountPath {\"enabled\":false}`
prod-flags-bot: feature flag ff.newAccountPath set to false by noah (oncall-sre)
miguel (db): requesting infra approval to terminate PID 10123 (analytics-export). It appears long-running and likely safe to kill mid-run
infra-bot: Terminate request queued for PID 10123. Owner: infra-ops. Approve?
arya (oncall-sre): approve termination.
infra-bot: Session 10123 terminated. Client disconnected.
miguel (db): migration resumed: `ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN email_verified boolean;` now completed. Running data backfill `UPDATE users SET email_verified = false;`
sara (backend): canary replica smoke tests: user create -> OK, login -> OK. Code now sees `email_verified` column present
arya (oncall-sre): monitoring: 500 rate returned to baseline in eu-west-1 canary. No increase in error budget.
liam (support): CS working message: drafting targeted note to acme-corp, beta-shop, edu-platform. Estimated affected window ~14 minutes for EU canary region only
tess (product): product note: new-account-flow flag will stay disabled until we complete postmortem and add a preflight check for migrations in future rollouts
noah (oncall-sre): handover: i'm taking the post-incident ownership. Summary and logs copied to /incidents/INC-2026-241/ (will create doc). arya handing off live ops
arya (oncall-sre): handing over. Key facts: root cause blocked DB migration due to analytics job holding exclusive lock; trigger was enabling new-account DB-dependent path in canary; mitigations: stopped canary, toggled feature flag off, killed blocking session, verified smoke tests
miguel (db): followups I'll own: add migration preflight that checks for long-running COPY/EXPORT jobs and aborts deployment or schedules migration; also add safer alter patterns (ADD COLUMN with DEFAULT NULL + backfill in batches)
sara (backend): followups I'll own: make accounts-service tolerate missing `email_verified` on reads (fallback to NULL) and gate field access behind feature flag check so rollouts don't break if migration lags
tess (product): i'll own customer comms and the feature flag policy change
liam (support): i'll finalize customer notifications and triage incoming tickets
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident INC-2026-241 resolved at 1830560800 by noah (oncall-sre). Downgraded to P3 for postmortem work
noah (oncall-sre): closing incident thread. Postmortem due EOD tomorrow. If anything regresses reopen or ping pagers. :thumbsup:
